title: Addressing the Publication manager
description: How to write for a reader acting as Publication manager. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `publication-manager` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Release-shaped: what ships, what is held, what authorised it
rules.description: Release-shaped: what ships, what is held, what authorised it. Dates and refs, not adjectives.

source.quote: Owns the release. Cares about what is authorised, what is built and what is public — and about the gap between them.
